post.title: Ofgem's January 2027 energy price cap: what it means for household energy bills
post.description: Ofgem's January to March 2027 cap is {{jan_total:gbp}} a year for typical use, {{jan_change_pct:spct1}} on October to December. Holding energy use fixed, we estimate average household energy spending in Great Britain changes by {{mean_change:sgbp}} a year.
